# Font-palette audit fixture

`COLR-palettes-test-font.ttf` is the WPT palette test face at Chromium revision
`7d859f271cbda744098ac69f44978d4edfa62be3`:

`third_party/blink/web_tests/external/wpt/css/css-fonts/resources/COLR-palettes-test-font.ttf`

The exact Git blob is `0f28caf21e6fde2660c251471f528e4ed21b82a3` and the
file SHA-256 is
`39002caac7857a2553ab2f9c832755b91a9c5976a6a303a927837d76a333f607`.
It is a deterministic Ahem-derived COLR v0 / CPAL v1 test face distributed as
part of Web Platform Tests under the WPT 3-clause BSD license. The audit checks
the digest and table contract before launching Chromium.
